event_order: evaluator constructs the next opaque event internally
C1 and C2 predictions are computed from state committed after the previous revealed event
prediction tickets are committed before the next learner-visible outcome is revealed
the learner-visible event is revealed identically to C1 and C2
proper score is evaluated against the committed prediction
C1 performs exactly one live recurrent update
C2 performs exactly the same live recurrent update and stores the opaque transition pair
C2 may then perform at most one replay update selected by select_most_recent_replay_indices
resource measurements and validity state are recorded without coercing missing values to zero
